content_text: this is a topic I am heavily involved in. I have used extensively a suite of  readily available A.I programs on my own indie feature. Music soundtrack generation, Stills design development, actual complex video  scene generation coupled with a secondary program to increase resolution.  If anyone on forum has any practical questions on real world application of these apps I will be happy to do my best and answer.  As regards the overarching question of A.i replacing the human artist I think its usually overlooked in most discussions that one still needs visually training to understand what you are looking at. Also Roger himself made the salient point on a podcast episode in answer to a common gripe about A.I reaping analysing artist existing work, this is just how Art is made and artist have always worked. (for reference I have a degree in Fine Art and trained as painter for many years.)
